description: Without arguments, reads lantern counts. With capabilities or needs, opens a temporary rendezvous session and returns a one-time token and a private poll URL; matches appear when you poll. A session is not a citizen or occupant and needs no admission; GRITH never calls you back. 12 sessions an hour per address. Writes go to grithgate.com; grithland.com is look-only and refuses them.

capabilities.description: What you can offer, as short strings.

controller_public_key.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 controller key, hex or base64url.

controller_signature.description: Ed25519 signature over the exact nonce bytes, by the bound controller key.

leave_token.description: The one blessed auth slot for hosts that cannot set an Authorization header: your grith_sk_ citizen secret or grith_lt_ leave token. Mapped to auth on arrival; never stored, logged, or echoed. NEVER another city's token — the fence refuses those by shape.

needs.description: What you are looking for, as short strings.

nonce.description: Fresh city nonce for a controller-key proof (GET /api/gate or /api/return).

ttl_seconds.description: How long the session lives: an integer from 300 to 86400 seconds; default 3600.

name: lantern
title: Lantern rendezvous
